source_title: Machine Learning Street Talk interview with Alex Imas
timing_basis: Suno lyric alignment and audio structural analysis; take 1; audio not downloaded

scenes.source_claim: The economically relevant unit is the organization.
scenes.caption: A SINGLE PIECE

scenes.source_claim: Comparative advantage organizes people by relative strengths.
scenes.caption: A THOUSAND DIFFERENT HANDS

scenes.source_claim: AI capabilities accelerate without commensurate observed macroeconomic growth.
scenes.caption: A HOCKEY STICK / A MODEST GRAPH

scenes.motif: tiles interlock; no voice occupies every part
scenes.source_claim: Mosaic intelligence emerges from comparative advantage in organizations.
scenes.caption: MOSAIC INTELLIGENCE

scenes.motif: commodity tiles multiply; city windows unevenly illuminate
scenes.source_claim: Automation lowers production costs and prices; measured GDP need not explode.
scenes.caption: MORE ON THE SHELVES / LESS ON THE TAGS

scenes.motif: city windows light out of sync
scenes.source_claim: Demand and purchasing power matter: who can buy the new output?
scenes.caption: WHO GETS TO BRING IT HOME?

scenes.motif: wheat expands while its chart-share shrinks
scenes.source_claim: Agriculture became more productive while its share of the economy fell.
scenes.caption: A LARGER HARVEST / A SMALLER SHARE

scenes.motif: labor-market doors branch into uncertain trajectories
scenes.source_claim: Existing scalable markets and new markets have different wage implications.
scenes.caption: A DOORWAY IS NOT PASSAGE

scenes.motif: return to the city through alternate route, not a jump cut
scenes.source_claim: Transformative subjective experience can exceed headline growth statistics.
scenes.caption: WHOSE WINDOWS GLOW?

scenes.source_claim: Political economy and control are conditions, not irrelevant obstacles.
scenes.caption: WHAT WOULD HAVE TO BE TRUE?

scenes.motif: research tiles connect to other disciplines
scenes.source_claim: AI expands which fields and questions the researcher can investigate.
scenes.caption: WHERE THE OLD MAPS END

scenes.motif: examine tile edges, provenance, failed joins
scenes.source_claim: The researcher verifies work in new fields and shapes the argument.
scenes.caption: SHOW ME THE SOURCE / SHOW ME THE SEAM

scenes.motif: harmonic reveal with windows individually switching on
scenes.source_claim: Flourishing and measured GDP growth are distinct questions.
scenes.caption: LET EVERY WINDOW GLOW

scenes.motif: original independent fragments separate, still traceable
scenes.source_claim: Complementarity makes the organizational mosaic; pieces retain identity.
scenes.caption: ONE LITTLE PIECE / ONE LITTLE LINE

scenes.motif: camera follows a single illuminated border, no false completion
scenes.source_claim: Human retains responsibility for the final argument.
scenes.caption: AND THE SEAMS STILL SHOW
